1.title: Why General LLMs Will Control Physical Robots | Thijs Simonian
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Stanford builder discusses scaling a Discord bot to 1.6M servers, getting hired at OpenAI's robotics team, and using Astra LLM to demonstrate general-purpose robot control without task-specific training.

1.title: The Lab Data Proves the Intelligence Explosion Is a Myth | Ramez Naam
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Ramez Naam argues AI recursive self-improvement faces diminishing returns based on OpenAI/Anthropic system cards data; covers feedback loop weakness, compute/data constraints, and five-year scaling outlook.

1.title: Why Simulation Fails for Dexterous Robots | Brian Potter
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Brian Potter on why simulation fails for robot dexterity, how Vision-Language-Action models + cheap hardware (UMI) are changing the constraint, and the connection to why prefab housing can't scale without general-purpose automation.
